name: Corticarte Apa Lagranges
original_name: コーティカルテ・アパ・ラグランジェス
source:
Corticarte in adult form.

The spirit Phoron made a contract with. Corti, as Phoron calls her, is one of the eldest spirits in their world, having six wings, and is known as the Red Elder Spirit — as well as other titles including Crimson Annihilator or Bloody Duchess. She was entranced by the young Phoron's singing voice and thus decided to make a pact with him so he would be hers and hers only.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Shinkyoku_S%C5%8Dkai_Polyphonica_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
